title: Building health-literate artificial intelligence
title_zh: 构建健康素养人工智能
abstract: This Perspective asks whether systems mediated by artificial intelligence (AI) can support health communication and health literacy rather than shifting interpretive burden onto users. We define health-literate AI as AI designed to align information, guidance and responsibility with users' abilities, contexts and needs. We propose four interrelated components: comprehension, agency, accountability and proportionality. These components help distinguish systems that are merely accurate or explainable from systems designed to support users in understanding what matters, what uncertainties remain and what to do next. We argue that the principles of health-literate AI should inform design, evaluation, research and governance across health-relevant AI ecosystems, so that innovation supports understanding, informed action and institutional responsibility.
abstract_zh: 本观点文章探讨由人工智能（AI）介入的系统是否能够支持健康传播和健康素养，而非将解释负担转移给用户。我们将健康素养AI定义为旨在将信息、指导与责任与用户的能力、语境和需求相协调的AI系统。我们提出了四个相互关联的组成部分：理解、能动性、问责与比例性。这些组成部分有助于区分仅仅准确或可解释的系统，与那些旨在支持用户理解关键点、剩余不确定性以及后续行动的系统。我们认为，健康素养AI的原则应指导健康相关AI生态系统中的设计、评估、研究与治理，以确保创新支持理解、明智行动和机构的责任。
